name: remove-dead-code
description: Confirm the suite is green, then remove one coherent group of unused code per iteration — exports, classes, files, retired flags — test it, and review it. Deletions score soft, not blocking.
rules: Each card's intent cites the proof it is unused: the requirement's tool output (knip, ts-prune, vulture, PMD or IntelliJ inspections) and a reference search (git grep over code AND resources) for reflection, DI by name, Spring bean names and config.
Generated sources do not count as unused.
Public entry points belong in LOOP.md's contracts, not in a deletion.
